source_detail: SEC 10-Q revenue disaggregation and segment note
calculation_or_source: Uses filed revenue-by-type and segment equipment-rental tables
what_it_says: The 10-Q exposes owned-equipment rental revenue and segment equipment-rental economics.
what_it_does_not_say: It still does not expose asset-level utilization, rate/time/mix split, growth-versus-replacement capex, or fleet ROIC.
next_source: Investor deck, transcript, fleet category schedules, and management discussion

calculation_or_source: Owned equipment rentals total for three months ended June 30 2026
what_it_says: The 10-Q separates owned-equipment rental revenue from re-rent and ancillary revenue.
what_it_does_not_say: Owned-equipment rental revenue still does not split rate versus time utilization versus mix.

calculation_or_source: Re-rent revenue total for three months ended June 30 2026
what_it_says: Re-rent is small relative to owned-rental revenue in Q2 2026.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not identify margin or supplier exposure for re-rented assets.

metric: Total ancillary and other rental revenues
calculation_or_source: Delivery and pick-up 341M plus other ancillary/other rental revenues 429M
what_it_says: Ancillary revenue is a meaningful part of equipment rentals revenue.
what_it_does_not_say: Ancillary revenue is not owned-fleet rent and can have different margin behavior.

calculation_or_source: Delivery and pick-up revenue for three months ended June 30 2026
what_it_says: Delivery/pick-up is separately visible inside ancillary rental revenue.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not disclose delivery cost or margin by service.

metric: Other ancillary and other rental revenue
calculation_or_source: Other ancillary and other rental revenues for three months ended June 30 2026
what_it_says: Other ancillary revenue is separately visible in the Q2 10-Q.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not specify asset class or service mix.

calculation_or_source: Total equipment rentals revenue for three months ended June 30 2026
what_it_says: The 10-Q reconciles owned rentals, re-rent, and ancillary items to equipment rentals revenue.
what_it_does_not_say: Total equipment rentals is not pure owned-fleet rental revenue.

metric: Owned equipment rentals share of equipment rentals
what_it_says: Owned rentals made up 77.7% of Q2 equipment rentals revenue.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not prove utilization or asset-level return.

what_it_says: Re-rent was only 2.3% of Q2 equipment rentals revenue.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not prove re-rent economics are immaterial to margin.

what_it_says: Ancillary and other rental revenue was 20.0% of Q2 equipment rentals revenue.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not behave like owned-equipment rental revenue for return analysis.

calculation_or_source: Owned equipment rentals total for six months ended June 30 2026
what_it_says: The H1 owned-rental denominator is visible.
what_it_does_not_say: It still does not split rate, time utilization, and mix.

calculation_or_source: Total equipment rentals revenue for six months ended June 30 2026
what_it_says: H1 total equipment-rental revenue is visible.
what_it_does_not_say: It includes owned rentals, re-rent, and ancillary revenue.

metric: Owned equipment rentals share of equipment rentals
what_it_says: Owned rentals made up 78.1% of H1 equipment rentals revenue.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not prove owned-fleet ROIC or utilization.

metric: Owned equipment rentals share of total revenue
what_it_says: Owned equipment rentals accounted for 67.6% of H1 total revenue.
what_it_does_not_say: This does not make all company revenue fleet-rental revenue.

what_it_says: Re-rent remained a small portion of H1 equipment rentals revenue.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not disclose re-rent cost or margin.

what_it_says: Ancillary and other rental revenue was 19.6% of H1 equipment rentals revenue.
what_it_does_not_say: It should not be treated as owned-fleet rent in utilization analysis.

calculation_or_source: General rentals equipment rentals for three months ended June 30 2026
what_it_says: General rentals remains the larger equipment-rental segment by revenue.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not disclose asset-level OEC or utilization for the segment.

calculation_or_source: Specialty equipment rentals for three months ended June 30 2026
what_it_says: Specialty is a large minority of equipment-rental revenue.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not split specialty categories such as trench, power/HVAC, fluid solutions, storage, or mats.

metric: Specialty share of equipment rentals revenue
what_it_says: Specialty was 37.2% of Q2 equipment-rental revenue.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not prove specialty utilization or ROIC.

calculation_or_source: General rentals equipment-rentals gross profit for three months ended June 30 2026
what_it_says: General rentals produced 865M USD of Q2 equipment-rentals gross profit.
what_it_does_not_say: Gross profit is before SG&A, interest, taxes, and non-rental depreciation/amortization.

calculation_or_source: Specialty equipment-rentals gross profit for three months ended June 30 2026
what_it_says: Specialty produced 636M USD of Q2 equipment-rentals gross profit.
what_it_does_not_say: It is not net income or ROIC.

calculation_or_source: Filed equipment-rentals gross margin
what_it_says: General rentals Q2 equipment-rentals gross margin was 35.8%.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not include full corporate expense allocation.

calculation_or_source: Filed equipment-rentals gross margin
what_it_says: Specialty Q2 equipment-rentals gross margin was 44.4%, above general rentals.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not prove specialty ROIC or asset utilization.

metric: Specialty share of equipment-rentals gross profit
what_it_says: Specialty produced 42.4% of Q2 equipment-rentals gross profit on 37.2% of equipment-rental revenue.
what_it_does_not_say: This does not prove specialty has higher full-cycle ROIC.

calculation_or_source: Capital expenditures for six months ended June 30 2026
what_it_says: General rentals received 2.279B USD of H1 segment capital expenditures.
what_it_does_not_say: Segment capex includes rental and non-rental equipment and is not split growth/replacement.

calculation_or_source: Capital expenditures for six months ended June 30 2026
what_it_says: Specialty received 817M USD of H1 segment capital expenditures.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not split by specialty category or growth/replacement.

metric: Specialty share of segment capital expenditures
what_it_says: Specialty was 26.4% of H1 segment capex versus 36.1% of H1 equipment-rental revenue and 41.1% of H1 equipment-rentals gross profit.
what_it_does_not_say: This timing proxy does not prove underinvestment or higher ROIC.

metric: General rentals capex divided by equipment rentals revenue
what_it_says: General rentals H1 capex was 49.0% of H1 equipment-rental revenue.
what_it_does_not_say: This is a half-year intensity proxy, not return.

metric: Specialty capex divided by equipment rentals revenue
what_it_says: Specialty H1 capex was 31.2% of H1 equipment-rental revenue.
what_it_does_not_say: This is a timing proxy and not proof of capital-light returns.

value: gross profit and return on assets
calculation_or_source: CODM uses equipment-rentals gross profit and compares segment return on assets when allocating resources
what_it_says: Management itself frames segment capital allocation around gross profit and return on assets.
what_it_does_not_say: The filing does not provide a clean segment ROA calculation or asset-level ROIC.

calculation_or_source: CODM considers monthly budget-to-actual variances for equipment rentals gross profit when allocating capital
what_it_says: The source links rental-equipment purchases to monitored segment gross-profit performance.
what_it_does_not_say: It does not disclose the actual internal hurdle rate or purchase-by-purchase funding source.

calculation_or_source: Owned-rental revenue plus segment equipment-rental revenue, gross profit, margin, capex, and CODM allocation language
what_it_says: URI now has filed support separating owned-rental revenue from re-rent/ancillary revenue and separating general-rentals versus specialty segment economics.
what_it_does_not_say: Do not call this true utilization, asset-level ROIC, rate/time/mix proof, or growth/replacement capex proof.
